description: Source code for a Mem0 memory node class implementing chat memory management with methods for loading, saving, and retrieving chat messages, including user ID handling and database interactions.

classes.name: Mem0_Memory
classes.description: Implements chat memory management, including loading, saving, and retrieving messages, with user ID handling based on toggle state.

classes.name: Mem0MemoryExtended
classes.description: Extends BaseMem0Memory to add user ID management, chat message retrieval, and context management for Mem0 chat memory.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the Mem0 memory node with provided data.

methods.name: loadMemoryVariables
methods.description: Loads memory variables for a given user, considering override user ID.

methods.name: saveContext
methods.description: Saves the current context (input/output) for a user, unless in search-only mode.

methods.name: getChatMessages
methods.description: Retrieves chat messages from database, optionally prepends system message from memory history.

methods.name: addChatMessages
methods.description: Adds new chat messages and saves context.

methods.name: clearChatMessages
methods.description: Clears chat messages from database for a user.
